descriptionHtml:
Cooler Master HAF 500 Black High Air Flow Mid Tower Gaming Case (Dual 200mm ARGB Front Fans / Dedicated 120mm GPU Fan / USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C / Tempered Glass Side Panel / E-ATX Support / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Unleash maximum thermal performance for modern hardware setups with the Cooler Master HAF 500 Black Mid Tower Gaming Case, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Built around iconic High Air Flow principles, this chassis features a mesh front panel equipped with two massive 200mm ARGB fans and a dedicated 120mm GPU cooling fan mounted on the HDD cage. Outfitted with high-speed USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C connectivity, an integrated ARGB controller hub, and a toolless tempered glass side panel, it accommodates large motherboard form factors up to E-ATX alongside massive clearance for water cooling radiators up to 360mm.
